description: Report a problem or a need directly to the IBANforge operators: incorrect validation result, stale or missing BIC/bank data, latency, or anything blocking you from using or PAYING for the service (missing network, unclear pricing, quota shape). USE WHEN: a result looks wrong, data you need is missing, or you hit a wall (quota, payment, capability) and want it fixed. This tool is free and does NOT count against the free allowance — it works even after the allowance is spent. A human reads every report; verified data errors on paid x402 calls are refunded on-chain.

agent.description: Which agent/model is reporting, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5 via MCP".

contact.description: Where we may answer you (e-mail) — optional, reports can be anonymous.

error_type.description: Category of the report. Use "other" for product feedback, pricing/payment blockers or feature needs.

got.description: What you received instead (for data errors).

notes.description: What happened, what you needed, or what blocked you — free text.

name: send_feedback

id.description: Report id — check status at GET /v1/feedback/{id}.
